remarks: Welcome to 165 Windham Lane in Grand Island! This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial, built in 2015, sits on just shy of an acre and features numerous updates throughout. Built with BuildSmart green building features, the home offers an updated kitchen, finished basement room, and heated garage with storage shelving. The backyard features an inground pool installed in 2023, outdoor bar and decorative concrete patio. A decorative concrete driveway adds to the property's curb appeal. Additional improvements include an HVAC tune-up completed in 2026. With nearly an acre of land, plenty of indoor and outdoor living space, and a convenient Grand Island location, this property offers a great combination of updates, amenities, and functionality. Move-in ready and ideal for entertaining!
